title: Taipei at Year-End: Choose Your Experiences
intro: Family and friends aged 11–70 will see the same experience cards. Each card asks only whether you are interested; different experiences at the same place can be chosen separately. Planning currently assumes 2026, and durations are estimates. Shops, prices, exhibitions, weather and accessibility needs should be confirmed before the trip.

dadaocheng-sunset.title: Watch the sunset at Dadaocheng Wharf
dadaocheng-sunset.description: Stroll along the Tamsui River and pause to watch the sky change. The river and city at dusk are the main attraction.
dadaocheng-sunset.sourceTitle: Dadaocheng Wharf / Container Market | Tourism Administration attraction data (Taipei City source)

facts.cost: Confirm on site or with official announcements
facts.mobility: Outdoor walking; bicycles also use the riverside. Keep warm in windy weather.
facts.seasonalNote: Sunset colors and visibility depend on the weather; a glowing sky is not guaranteed.

dadaocheng-sunset.imageAlt: Dadaocheng Wharf / Container Market — location photo: Sunlight over the river at sunset (source: Taipei City Department of Information and Tourism)
dadaocheng-sunset.imageCredit: Taipei City Department of Information and Tourism / Tourism Administration open data (original photo attribution follows); Sunlight over the river at sunset (source: Taipei City Department of Information and Tourism)

dadaocheng-food.title: Have dinner at the wharf's container market
dadaocheng-food.description: After enjoying the river view, choose a meal in the container dining area and sit down to chat. This is a separate choice from watching the sunset.
dadaocheng-food.sourceTitle: Dadaocheng Wharf / Container Market | Tourism Administration attraction data (Taipei City source)

facts.cost: Confirm on site or with official announcements
facts.mobility: Outdoor dining and walking; at busy times, you may need to queue or wait for a seat.
facts.seasonalNote: Shops, seating and operating arrangements depend on conditions that day.

dadaocheng-food.imageAlt: Dadaocheng Wharf / Container Market — location photo: Sunlight over the river at sunset (source: Taipei City Department of Information and Tourism)

dihua-architecture.title: Explore Dihua Street's old shophouses
dihua-architecture.description: Notice the red brick, decorated facades and narrow, deep shophouses. Photograph your favorite architectural details as you walk.
dihua-architecture.sourceTitle: Dadaocheng / Dihua Street Shophouses | Tourism Administration attraction data (Taipei City source)

facts.cost: Confirm on site or with official announcements
facts.mobility: Walking along arcades and streets; watch for intersections, thresholds and crowds.

dihua-architecture.imageCredit: Taipei City Department of Information and Tourism / Tourism Administration open data (original photo attribution follows); Historic red-brick arcades

dihua-gifts.title: Browse dried goods and gifts on Dihua Street
dihua-gifts.description: Explore traditional shops and pick a taste or two to take home. Browsing without buying is welcome too.
dihua-gifts.sourceTitle: Dadaocheng / Dihua Street Shophouses | Tourism Administration attraction data (Taipei City source)

facts.cost: Confirm on site or with official announcements
facts.mobility: Walking in and out of shops; some interiors are narrow.
facts.seasonalNote: This is an ordinary shopping visit; unannounced Lunar New Year market events are not included.

dihua-gifts.imageCredit: Taipei City Department of Information and Tourism / Tourism Administration open data (original photo attribution follows); Historic red-brick arcades

yongle-fabric.title: Find a fabric you love at Yongle Market
yongle-fabric.description: Compare patterns, textures and threads, and imagine turning them into a bag, clothing or something for your home.

facts.cost: Confirm on site or with official announcements
facts.mobility: Indoor market with several floors; check the aisles and lifts on site.

xiahai-temple.title: Observe daily life at Xiahai City God Temple
xiahai-temple.description: Look at the temple details and people coming to worship, and explore Dadaocheng's local religious life. Taking part in worship is your choice.
xiahai-temple.sourceTitle: Taipei Xiahai City God Temple | Tourism Administration attraction data (Taipei City source)

facts.cost: Confirm on site or with official announcements
facts.mobility: Watch for crowds and thresholds in the temple forecourt; respect worshippers' routes.

raohe-savory.title: Try savory snacks at Raohe Night Market

raohe-soup.title: Sit down for hot soup at Raohe Night Market

facts.mobility: Check seating, queues and allergens with the stall.

ningxia-meal.title: Share Taiwanese snacks at Ningxia Night Market

ningxia-meal.sourceTitle: Taipei City Department of Information and Tourism | Taipei Food Guide

facts.mobility: Aisles can be crowded; check allergies and dietary restrictions before sharing.

ningxia-snack.description: Make a taro snack, such as a taro cake with egg yolk, your one small goal. You can leave after eating rather than browse all evening.
ningxia-snack.sourceTitle: Taipei City Department of Information and Tourism | Taipei Food Guide

east-ramen.title: Find a bowl of hot ramen in the East District
east-ramen.description: Plan a Japanese ramen meal: choose a shop together based on broth richness and flavor, then sit down for hot noodles. This is a meal idea; the shop is undecided.
east-ramen.sourceTitle: Taipei City Department of Information and Tourism | Taipei Food Guide

facts.cost: Confirm on site or with official announcements
facts.mobility: Confirm queues, seating, stairs and dietary requirements after choosing a shop.
facts.seasonalNote: No shop has been selected or recommended; the official source only confirms the shopping district's location and dining character.

yongkang-tea.title: Spend an afternoon over tea on Yongkang Street
yongkang-tea.description: Explore the lanes for a tea house or cafe, and let a drink become a chance to sit down and chat.
yongkang-tea.sourceTitle: Taipei City Department of Information and Tourism | Taipei Food Guide

facts.cost: Confirm on site or with official announcements
facts.mobility: Confirm seating, minimum spend and entrance access after choosing a shop.

101-observatory.title: See the city from Taipei 101

101-observatory.sourceTitle: Taipei 101 | Tourism Administration attraction data (Taipei City source)

facts.cost: Confirm on site or with official announcements
facts.mobility: Indoor lifts and walking; tickets, entry routes and services follow official announcements.
facts.seasonalNote: Cloud or mist may limit the view. Unconfirmed New Year's Eve fireworks and outdoor high-altitude activities are not included.

101-shopping.title: Browse and dine at Taipei 101's mall
101-shopping.description: Focus on the indoor mall, window displays and food. Take your time in a shop; visiting the observatory is optional.
101-shopping.sourceTitle: Taipei 101 | Tourism Administration attraction data (Taipei City source)

facts.cost: Confirm on site or with official announcements

fourfour-village.title: Frame old and new Taipei at Four Four South Village

fourfour-village.sourceTitle: Xinyi Public Assembly Hall and Four Four South Village Cultural Park | Tourism Administration attraction data (Taipei City source)

facts.cost: Confirm on site or with official announcements
facts.mobility: Walking outdoors and in old buildings; check thresholds, surfaces and open areas on site.

xinyi-stroll.title: Enjoy Xinyi's windows and streets at night
xinyi-stroll.description: Explore department-store plazas and pedestrian streets for lights, window displays and people. You can enjoy the city's evening without buying anything.
xinyi-stroll.sourceTitle: Xinyi Shopping District | Tourism Administration attraction data (Taipei City source)

facts.cost: Confirm on site or with official announcements

facts.mobility: Indoor gallery walking; plan breaks and check official information on services and routes.

npm-garden.title: Explore the Palace Museum's buildings and gardens

npm-garden.sourceTitle: National Palace Museum Northern Branch | Opening Hours and Gardens

facts.mobility: Outdoor walking with slopes or stairs; open routes follow official announcements.

facts.cost: Confirm on site or with official announcements
facts.mobility: Indoor and outdoor movement in a historic complex; check thresholds and routes between floors with the museum.

tfam-art.title: See a current exhibition at Taipei Fine Arts Museum

tfam-building.description: Treat the museum itself as an artwork. Look at its intersecting white buildings, plaza and outdoor sculptures.
tfam-building.sourceTitle: Taipei Fine Arts Museum | Tourism Administration attraction data (Taipei City source)

facts.cost: Confirm on site or with official announcements
facts.mobility: Walking in the plaza and museum; open areas follow museum announcements.

facts.cost: Confirm on site or with official announcements

huashan-buildings.title: Trace Huashan's old brewery buildings

facts.cost: Confirm on site or with official announcements

red-house.title: Explore the Red House and its creative shops

facts.cost: Confirm on site or with official announcements

facts.cost: Confirm on site or with official announcements
facts.mobility: Slopes and very hot water; obey barriers and warning signs. Do not enter the water.
facts.seasonalNote: Steam effects depend on the weather; opening and maintenance follow official announcements.

beitou-bath.title: Plan some private hot spring time in Beitou
beitou-bath.description: Choose a place with a private bathing room for a quiet soak and rest. The venue, spring type and use rules need separate confirmation.
beitou-bath.sourceTitle: Xinbeitou Hot Spring District | Tourism Administration attraction data (Taipei City source)

facts.cost: Confirm on site or with official announcements
facts.mobility: Consider your personal health before bathing; confirm entrances, handrails and water temperature with the venue.
facts.seasonalNote: No operator has been chosen or booked; the photo shows the hot spring district, not a particular bathing room.

maokong-path.title: Walk past tea fields on Maokong's Zhangshu Trail
maokong-path.description: Walk part of a mountain trail through tea fields and rural scenery. Reaching a summit is not the goal.
maokong-path.sourceTitle: Maokong Zhangshu Trail | Tourism Administration attraction data (Taipei City source)

facts.cost: Confirm on site or with official announcements
facts.mobility: An outdoor trail with some changes in elevation; it may be slippery after rain. Adjust the distance to suit yourself.
facts.seasonalNote: No December flower fields are promised; check mountain weather and road conditions before leaving.

dahu-lake.title: Find bridges and reflections at Dahu Park
dahu-lake.description: Stroll along the lake and frame the bridge, mountains and water in one photo. You do not have to climb the arched bridge.
dahu-lake.sourceTitle: Dahu Park | Tourism Administration attraction data (Taipei City source)

facts.cost: Confirm on site or with official announcements
facts.mobility: Lakeside walking; the arched bridge has stairs, and you can choose not to climb it.

guandu-temple.title: See temple carvings and river views at Guandu
guandu-temple.description: Look at traditional craftsmanship in the eaves, stone carvings and temple spaces, then allow time for the riverside.
guandu-temple.sourceTitle: Taipei Guandu Temple Foundation | Tourism Administration attraction data (Taipei City source)

facts.cost: Confirm on site or with official announcements
facts.mobility: The temple grounds have level changes and stairs; choose routes to suit your stamina and respect worshippers.

riverside-cycle.title: Cycle a short stretch of the Keelung River
riverside-cycle.description: Choose a riverside route for an easy-paced ride, enjoying the wind, river and bridges. Set the distance and turning point with your companions.
riverside-cycle.sourceTitle: Keelung River Riverside Cycle Path | Tourism Administration attraction data (Taipei City source)

facts.cost: Confirm on site or with official announcements
facts.mobility: You need to be able to cycle safely; confirm rentals, bike types, helmets and route conditions separately.
facts.seasonalNote: Reschedule for rain, strong wind or route closures. Do not assume cycling suits everyone.
